title: On the Reproducibility of “FairCLIP: Harnessing Fairness in Vision-Language Learning”

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot classification and linear probing performance disparities across racial groups (e.g., Asian, Black, White) using Demographic Parity Distance (DPD), Difference in Equalized Odds (DEOdds), and Equity-Scaled AUC (ES-AUC).
Measuring fairness metrics (DPD, DEOdds, ES-AUC) and group-wise AUC between male and female individuals in medical image classification and zero-shot prediction tasks.
Assessing performance gaps and fairness metrics (DPD, DEOdds) between Hispanic and Non-Hispanic groups during zero-shot medical image classification.
Evaluating differences in model performance and fairness metrics across patients with different preferred languages (English, Spanish, Others) on a medical dataset.
Measuring zero-shot prediction performance and fairness metrics across different demographic age groups (ranging from 0-2 to 70+) using a facial attribute dataset.
